description: The before-attachment fails on a shared verbatim gap before the later inserted item evaluates its failing tag query (engine §11).
grammar:
%rule text $b:bad $w:word %emits ($b) $w, ε :: $.tags(migration-fault) := "a"
%rule word "1"
%rule bad $l:left $r:right %emits $l, $r
%rule left "b" :- $.verbatim-text
%rule right "b" :- $.verbatim-text
%rule migration-fault ε | {_} %conditions "x" ∈ $.value.split($.value)
